import torch  # noqa: E402
import torch.nn.functional as F  # noqa: E402
import solution  # noqa: E402


@torch.no_grad()
def reference(hidden_states, weight, expert_bias, routed_scaling_factor):
    num_experts = 256
    top_k = 8
    n_group = 8
    topk_group = 4
    experts_per_group = num_experts // n_group
    num_tokens = hidden_states.shape[0]
    logits = F.linear(hidden_states.to(torch.float32), weight.to(torch.float32))
    scores = torch.sigmoid(logits)
    scores_for_routing = scores + expert_bias.to(torch.float32)
    grp = scores_for_routing.view(num_tokens, n_group, experts_per_group)
    top2_vals, _ = torch.topk(grp, k=2, dim=-1, largest=True, sorted=False)
    group_scores = top2_vals.sum(dim=-1)
    _, group_idx = torch.topk(group_scores, k=topk_group, dim=-1, sorted=False)
    group_mask = torch.zeros_like(group_scores)
    group_mask.scatter_(1, group_idx, 1.0)
    score_mask = group_mask.unsqueeze(-1).expand(num_tokens, n_group, experts_per_group).reshape(num_tokens, num_experts)
    neg_inf = torch.finfo(torch.float32).min
    masked_scores = scores_for_routing.masked_fill(score_mask == 0, neg_inf)
    _, topk_idx = torch.topk(masked_scores, k=top_k, dim=-1, sorted=False)
    selected_scores = torch.gather(scores, dim=1, index=topk_idx)
    topk_weight = selected_scores / (selected_scores.sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + 1e-20)
    topk_weight = topk_weight * routed_scaling_factor
    return topk_idx, topk_weight


torch.manual_seed(0)
T, K, E = 8, 4096, 256
hs = torch.randn(T, K, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
w = torch.randn(E, K, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
b = torch.randn(E, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")

print("torch", torch.__version__)
try:
    ridx, rwt = reference(hs, w, b, 2.5)
    sidx, swt = solution.run(hs, w, b, 2.5)
    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    for t in range(3):
        rset = set(ridx[t].tolist())
        sset = set(sidx[t].tolist())
        print(f"--- token {t} ---")
        print("ref idx (as returned):", ridx[t].tolist())
        print("sol idx (as returned):", sidx[t].tolist())
        print("ref idx sorted       :", sorted(rset))
        print("sol idx sorted       :", sorted(sset))
        print("SET equal            :", rset == sset, "| inter", len(rset & sset))
        # weights aligned to sorted index
        rmap = {int(i): float(v) for i, v in zip(ridx[t].tolist(), rwt[t].tolist())}
        smap = {int(i): float(v) for i, v in zip(sidx[t].tolist(), swt[t].tolist())}
        common = sorted(rset & sset)
        wdiff = max((abs(rmap[i] - smap[i]) for i in common), default=0.0)
        print("max weight diff (common idx):", wdiff)
        print("ref wt (as returned):", [round(x, 4) for x in rwt[t].tolist()])
        print("sol wt (as returned):", [round(x, 4) for x in swt[t].tolist()])
    # global set-match ratio
    setmatch = sum(set(ridx[t].tolist()) == set(sidx[t].tolist()) for t in range(T)) / T
    print("token set-match ratio:", setmatch)
except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
    print("=== FAILED ===")
    traceback.print_exc()
